items.title: Garissa residents want decentralised services for easier asset claims
items.description: The Unclaimed Financial Assets Authority (UFAA) should decentralise its services to make it easier for Kenyans to trace and reclaim their wealth without incurring the high costs of travelling to Nairobi.
items.excerpt: Muktar Dahir, chairperson Garissa Human Rights Network, giving his views at the forum. The Unclaimed Financial Assets Authority (UFAA) should decentralise its services to make it easier for Kenyans to trace and reclaim their wealth without incurring the high costs of travelling to Nairobi. Garissa residents say the public also has limited awareness and accessibility, particularly among people living in remote and marginalised areas who may be entitled to unclaimed funds.
